options.name: access_tier
options.description: The access tier for this storage account. Required when I(kind=BlobStorage).

options.name: account_type
options.description: Type of storage account. Required when creating a storage account. C(Standard_ZRS) and C(Premium_LRS) accounts cannot be changed to other account types. Other account types cannot be changed to C(Standard_ZRS) or C(Premium_LRS).

options.name: ad_user
options.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

options.name: adfs_authority_url
options.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

options.name: allow_blob_public_access
options.description: Allows blob containers in account to be set for anonymous public access. If set to false, no containers in this account will be able to allow anonymous public access. If omitted, new account creation will default to null which is currently interpreted to True. Existing accounts will not be modified.

options.name: allow_cross_tenant_replication
options.description: Allow or disallow cross AAD tenant object replication.

options.name: allow_shared_key_access
options.description: Indicates whether the storage account permits requests to be authorized with the account access key via Shared Key. If false, then all requests, including shared access signatures, must be authorized with Azure Active Directory (Azure AD). The default value is null, which is equivalent to true.

options.name: api_profile
options.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of C(latest) is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack.

options.name: append_tags
options.description: Use to control if tags field is canonical or just appends to existing tags. When canonical, any tags not found in the tags parameter will be removed from the object's metadata.

options.name: auth_mode
options.description: The mode in which to run the command. C(login) mode will directly use your login credentials for the authentication. The legacy C(key) mode will attempt to query for an account key if no authentication parameters for the account are provided. Can also be set via the environment variable C(AZURE_STORAGE_AUTH_MODE).

options.name: auth_source
options.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the C(ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE) environment variable. When set to C(auto) (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> C(env) -> C(credential_file) -> C(cli). When set to C(env), the credentials will be read from the environment variables. When set to C(credential_file), it will read the profile from C(~/.azure/credentials). When set to C(cli), the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile

options.name: blob_cors
options.description: Specifies CORS rules for the Blob service. You can include up to five CorsRule elements in the request. If no blob_cors elements are included in the argument list, nothing about CORS will be changed. If you want to delete all CORS rules and disable CORS for the Blob service, explicitly set I(blob_cors=[]).

options.name: cert_validation_mode
options.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing C(ignore). Can also be set via credential file profile or the C(AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION) environment variable.

options.name: client_id
options.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the C(AZURE_CLIENT_ID) environment variable.

options.name: cloud_environment
options.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, C(AzureChinaCloud), C(AzureUSGovernment)), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the C(AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT) environment variable.

options.name: custom_domain
options.description: User domain assigned to the storage account. Must be a dictionary with I(name) and I(use_sub_domain) keys where I(name) is the CNAME source. Only one custom domain is supported per storage account at this time. To clear the existing custom domain, use an empty string for the custom domain name property. Can be added to an existing storage account. Will be ignored during storage account creation.

options.name: default_to_o_auth_authentication
options.description: A boolean flag which indicates whether the default authentication is OAuth or not. The default interpretation is false for this property.

options.name: disable_instance_discovery
options.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validati

options.name: enable_nfs_v3
options.description: NFS 3.0 protocol.

options.name: encryption
options.description: The encryption settings on the storage account.

options.name: force_delete_nonempty
options.description: Attempt deletion if resource already exists and cannot be updated.

options.name: https_only
options.description: Allows https traffic only to storage service when set to C(True). If omitted, new account creation will default to True, while existing accounts will not be change.

options.name: identity
options.description: Identity for this resource.

options.name: immutable_storage_with_versioning
options.description: The property is immutable and can only be set to true at the account creation time. When set to true, it enables object level immutability for all the containers in the account by default.

options.name: is_hns_enabled
options.description: Account HierarchicalNamespace enabled if sets to true. When I(is_hns_enabled=True), I(kind) cannot be C(Storage).

options.name: kind
options.description: The kind of storage. The C(FileStorage) and (BlockBlobStorage) only used when I(account_type=Premium_LRS) or I(account_type=Premium_ZRS). C(Storage) (general-purpose v1) and C(BlobStorage) are legacy account kinds that Azure is retiring. Microsoft is disabling creation of new legacy blob storage accounts in September 2026 and will fully retire both kinds in October 2026 (any remaining accounts will be auto-migrated to C(StorageV2)). Use C(StorageV2) for all new accounts.

options.name: large_file_shares_state
options.description: Allow large file shares if sets to Enabled.

options.name: location
options.description: Valid Azure location. Defaults to location of the resource group.

options.name: log_mode
options.description: Parent argument.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Parent argument.

options.name: minimum_tls_version
options.description: The minimum required version of Transport Layer Security (TLS) for requests to a storage account. If omitted, new account creation will default to null which is currently interpreted to TLS1_0. Existing accounts will not be modified.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the storage account to update or create.

options.name: network_acls
options.description: Manages the Firewall and virtual networks settings of the storage account.

options.name: oidc_token
options.description: Direct OpenID Connect (OIDC) token (JWT) used for workload identity authentication. This token is exchanged with Azure AD using OIDC federated identity. Useful in CI systems (for example GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) where an OIDC token is provided directly by the platform. Can also be set via the C(AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: oidc_token_file_path
options.description: Path to a file containing an OpenID Connect (OIDC) token (JWT) used for workload identity authentication. The file must contain only raw token. This method is commonly used in platforms that materialize OIDC tokens as files Can also be set via the C(AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE) environment variable.

options.name: password
options.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

options.name: profile
options.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

options.name: public_network_access
options.description: Allow or disallow public network access to Storage Account.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: Name of the resource group to use.

options.name: secret
options.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: smb_oauth_enabled
options.description: Whether managed identities can access Azure Files SMB shares using OAuth. When unset, the value on Azure is left unchanged (the service default is C(false) for new accounts).

options.name: state
options.description: State of the storage account. Use C(present) to create or update a storage account and use C(absent) to delete an account. C(failover) is used to failover the storage account to its secondary. This process can take up to a hour.

options.name: static_website
options.description: Manage static website configuration for the storage account.

options.name: subscription_id
options.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

options.name: tags
options.description: Dictionary of string:string pairs to assign as metadata to the object. Metadata tags on the object will be updated with any provided values. To remove tags set append_tags option to false. Currently, Azure DNS zones and Traffic Manager services also don't allow the use of spaces in the tag. Azure Front Door doesn't support the use of Azure Automation and Azure CDN only support 15 tags on resources.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: thumbprint
options.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in I(x509_certificate_path). Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if I(x509_certificate_path) is defined.

options.name: x509_certificate_path
options.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.
